about: Blitz probe API compatibility manifest. `implementation` is the declared state of the probe source (present, present_incomplete, missing, unknown); report.mjs combines it with the ROVES_PROBE_RESULT evidence of one CI run into verified / present_incomplete / missing / unavailable / failed. Template usage was audited statically on DRincs-Productions/visual-novel-template (source + local build target/visual-novel-template-test, chunks index-BHhGmzZj.js, narration-hooks-BTWuZ1dT.js, motion-C9LT9cgV.js, pixi-vn-BQMlS_e_.js); CI rebuilds the template from its main branch, so chunk hashes differ.

apis.surface: getElementById, stable wrappers (===), GC of detached nodes
tree navigation/mutation, textContent, attributes, selectors, classList, innerHTML, cloneNode, comments, parentElement
createElementNS, Element.prefix, qualified tagName
apis.gaps: no setAttributeNS/getAttributeNS (attributes stay in the null namespace, xlink:href included); astral characters rejected in qualified names

apis.surface: live HTMLCollection (getElementsByTagName), static NodeList, MutationObserver, MessageChannel, requestIdleCallback, AbortController/AbortSignal (deno_web)
HTMLCanvasElement, HTMLIFrameElement, HTMLMediaElement/Audio/Video, HTMLInputElement/TextArea/Select brands, isContentEditable
apis.gaps: iframe nominal (no browsing context, by single-document policy); media canPlayType() returns "" and nothing plays; form brands expose `type` and, for text controls, `value`/`defaultValue` (see forms.input_value; no selection/validity/form owner)

apis.surface: element.style, getComputedStyle, Blitz/Stylo stylesheet and layout
Element.getAnimations({subtree}), CSSAnimation/CSSTransition, KeyframeEffect.getTiming, finished, monotonic document timeline
apis.gaps: no play/pause/cancel/Element.animate/document.getAnimations; Blitz accessor is a local vendored patch (patches/blitz-dom-0.3.0-beta.4)

apis.surface: CSS.supports, CSSStyleSheet, adoptedStyleSheets, insertRule
apis.template_use: narration-hooks (CSS.supports), narration chunk (adoptedStyleSheets/insertRule); not reached or guarded in the two-dialogue story run (0 errors)

apis.surface: getBoundingClientRect, matchMedia, focus/blur/activeElement, trusted pointer/mouse/keyboard events through Blitz hit-test
ResizeObserver on Blitz/Taffy boxes
window/element scroll*, scrollTop/Left, scroll/client sizes, scrollIntoView
apis.gaps: smooth behaviour applied instantly; no scroll events dispatched

apis.surface: Element.getClientRects, Range.getClientRects
apis.template_use: Floating UI positioning (guarded by `e.getClientRects ?`), React view transitions (inactive)

apis.surface: IntersectionObserver
apis.template_use: Floating UI layoutShift and lazy viewport rendering, both guarded by typeof

apis.surface: setPointerCapture/releasePointerCapture/hasPointerCapture
apis.template_use: Base UI ScrollArea thumb drag and slider (unguarded call on pointerdown)

apis.surface: `inert` attribute semantics (no hit-test/focus inside inert subtrees)
apis.gaps: the probe adds no inert handling; whether Blitz 0.3.0-beta.4 honours it in hit-testing/focus is not verified
apis.template_use: Base UI dialogs/popups mark the outside tree inert and set pointer-events:none

apis.surface: document.visibilityState/hidden, visibilitychange, pagehide, beforeunload at window close
apis.template_use: useAutoSaveOnPageClose (auto-exit save to localStorage), network hooks, Pixi ticker pause

apis.surface: requestAnimationFrame, deno_core microtasks, deno_web timers in the frame loop
real blitz-shell window, CPU paint, trusted OS click
apis.gaps: CPU (vello_cpu) page paint only; no GPU canvas compositing; scroll/wheel/touch events not forwarded to JS; key/IME text editing uses the fixture-verified EventDriver bridge but no real OS keyboard/IME input has been verified in the window

apis.surface: localStorage/sessionStorage (deno_webstorage), persistent across processes
IndexedDB subset: open/upgrade, createObjectStore/createIndex, put/get/delete, store and index cursors next/prev
apis.gaps: no atomic transactions/rollback, getAll/count/clear/KeyRange absent or NotSupportedError, shares the 10 MiB localStorage quota

apis.surface: History/Location single-document, scrollRestoration, root URL game://content/, navigator.onLine
deno_fetch: game:// reads, public https with CSP connect-src, refused private addresses
window.__ROVES__ and roves: requests (saves, system_info, achievements, Steam)
apis.template_use: @drincs/roves-api isAvailable(): production Servo saves through roves:saves; in the probe the template silently falls back to IndexedDB, so save files are not shared with production

apis.surface: Worker (classic, blob:/data:/game://), separate isolate with deno_web only
apis.gaps: no module workers, no DOM/fetch/createImageBitmap inside the worker

apis.surface: AudioContext on web-audio-api 1.7.0: gain, constant source, merger/splitter, stereo panner, AudioBuffer/BufferSource, decodeAudioData; Tone 15.1.22
apis.gaps: CI renders offline (no device sink verified); nodes outside the template's set not exposed

apis.surface: HTMLMediaElement src/play/load/events
apis.template_use: Pixi video assets (canPlayType answers "" so Pixi detects no video formats)

apis.surface: Motion 12.38.0 animate transform/opacity
navigator.gpu (deno_webgpu 0.227.0), single shared device, GPUCanvasContext offscreen, PixiJS 8.19.0 readback
apis.gaps: offscreen only; the DX12 diagnostic runs in normal mode only and the GitHub runner adapter is a CPU device

apis.surface: Pixi WebGPU canvas composited into the Blitz window
apis.template_use: every visible narrative frame (backgrounds, characters)

apis.surface: createImageBitmap/ImageBitmap (deno_image), copyExternalImageToTexture polyfill
apis.gaps: evidence only through the opt-in WebGPU fixture

apis.surface: getContext('2d') pixel subset (canvas, createImageData, getImageData, putImageData with dirty rectangle, ImageData from deno_web), context mode, resize clearing, toDataURL/toBlob PNG (png crate, op_blitz_encode_png) incl. async readback of a WebGPU canvas for toBlob, FileReader (deno_web); bitmap bound 16384 per side / 16 Mi pixels
apis.gaps: no drawImage, paths, fillRect, text/measureText, transforms, compositing, imageSmoothingEnabled, OffscreenCanvas; PNG only (other types fall back to PNG); toDataURL on a WebGPU canvas throws NotSupportedError (no synchronous readback); setAttribute('width') does not clear a 2D bitmap; straight-alpha storage (no premultiplied precision loss)
apis.template_use: Pixi extract.image for save thumbnails (canvas.extractImage: on WebGPU generateCanvas + toBlob + FileReader), Pixi Text/measureText, CanvasPool

apis.surface: HTMLImageElement/Image(), src/onload/decode/naturalWidth for explicit JS requests
apis.gaps: attribute-only DOM images use Blitz rendering without JS load state; no srcset, image element canvas source or GPU upload
apis.template_use: Pixi extract.image returns an Image whose `src` the save stores; Pixi image-element loading fallback

apis.surface: FontFace, document.fonts
apis.template_use: Pixi web-font loading for canvas text

apis.surface: HTMLInputElement/HTMLTextAreaElement value and defaultValue on Blitz's own editor (TextInputData), trusted InputEvent `input` from Blitz key/IME editing through the EventDriver bridge (keydown preventDefault cancels the edit), oninput, type state for invalid `type` values (Blitz patch 0003)
apis.gaps: no selectionStart/selectionEnd/setSelectionRange/select(), getSelection/createRange, `change` event, beforeinput, inputType/data, composition events, valueAsNumber or number sanitization, dirty-value flag (the `value` attribute rewrites the editor), form submission events; value writes refused on date/range/color/file-like types; window keyboard/IME text entry uses the same bridge but is not verified with real OS input
apis.template_use: InputRequestDialog name input (React controlled input + onChange/Enter), React's _valueTracker; React's selection restore falls back safely without selectionStart

apis.surface: <input type=file>.click() picker, input.files, FileReader
apis.template_use: save.loadFromFile (import save). FileReader from deno_web 0.291 (10_filereader.js) is loaded and global since the canvas export work; the picker and input.files are still missing

apis.surface: HTMLAnchorElement download + click() on a blob: URL
apis.template_use: save.download (export save JSON); needs a single-document/download policy decision

apis.surface: requestFullscreen/exitFullscreen/fullscreenElement/fullscreenEnabled
apis.template_use: Settings > system controls fullscreen toggle; diagnostics

apis.surface: navigator.clipboard.writeText
apis.template_use: Settings > diagnostics copy report

apis.surface: navigator.getGamepads
apis.template_use: diagnostics capability check only (typeof guarded)

apis.surface: crypto.getRandomValues/randomUUID
apis.template_use: narration-hooks (randomUUID), motion chunk (getRandomValues); not reached or guarded in the story run

apis.surface: Intl.Segmenter (V8 ICU data)
apis.gaps: ICU data availability in the probe's deno_core/V8 build not verified
apis.template_use: Pixi text splitting (motion chunk)
